_description: Key frontend/UI decisions with reasoning, alternatives, and outcomes

decision: Game Boy pixel-art 1-bit aesthetic with CRT overlay
reasoning: Distinctive retro feel that matches the tabletop RPG theme. 4-shade palette is simple to implement and creates strong visual identity.
outcome: Unique visual identity; palette system allows genre-based theming

reasoning: Each genre combination shifts the 4-shade palette. A cyberpunk campaign looks different from a dark fantasy one, creating visual variety without redesigning components.
outcome: 6 genre-specific palettes implemented, auto-switching based on selection

decision: Tailwind v4 with @theme for CSS variable overrides
reasoning: Tailwind v4 moved to @theme blocks instead of :root. Using :root would not work correctly with Tailwind's theme resolution.
outcome: Correct integration with Tailwind v4 theme system

decision: i18n strings use natural case; uppercase applied via CSS
reasoning: Storing uppercase in locale files makes them harder to reuse in different contexts. CSS text-transform is the correct layer for visual presentation.
alternatives: Store uppercase strings in locale files
outcome: Flexible text that can be styled differently per context

decision: 4-step wizard with genre-based carousel and cartridge slot UI
reasoning: Redesigned genre selection from simple checkboxes to a sidebar + carousel UI for better UX. Cartridge metaphor fits the Game Boy aesthetic.
outcome: More engaging and thematic genre selection experience

decision: CRT scanline overlay applied at viewport root, not on individual components
reasoning: Scanlines are a screen-level effect — applying per-component creates z-index conflicts and inconsistent rendering when components overlap or scroll.
outcome: Single overlay div covers the full viewport uniformly; no component-level overlay code

decision: Wizard as the main app shell instead of separate pages per step
reasoning: Generation state must survive step transitions — characters must still be visible when the user navigates to the script step. Separate pages would reset state or require complex URL-based persistence.
outcome: Pinia store persists state across steps; wizard navigation is instant with no page reload
